sales-skills.author: Louis Blythe

apple-design.title: Apple-style Motion & UI
apple-design.summary: Designs and reviews interfaces with Apple's feel: springy, interruptible motion, gestures, depth and careful typography. Can also give a strict critique of existing animations.
apple-design.try: Review the animations on my landing page and tell me what feels off.

ui-ux-designer.title: UI/UX Designer
ui-ux-designer.summary: Plans screens, user flows and design systems, and critiques existing product UX.
ui-ux-designer.try: Map out the onboarding flow for my habit-tracking app.

hairline-create.title: Hairline Line Art
hairline-create.summary: Draws an interactive isometric line-art figure that reacts to the mouse, delivered as a single HTML file.
hairline-create.try: /hairline-create a lighthouse whose beam follows the cursor

brand-strategist.title: Brand Strategist
brand-strategist.summary: Defines positioning, naming, brand voice and messaging so a brand stands apart from its competitors.
brand-strategist.try: Write a positioning statement for my AI-powered design studio.

content-strategist.title: Content Strategist
content-strategist.summary: Plans content that builds an audience: LinkedIn, SEO, newsletters, YouTube and product launches.
content-strategist.try: Build me a 4-week LinkedIn content plan.

copywriter.title: Copywriter
copywriter.summary: Writes copy that converts: ads, landing pages, emails, headlines and hooks.
copywriter.try: Write five headline options for my portfolio homepage.

dtc-growth-strategist.title: DTC Growth Strategist
dtc-growth-strategist.summary: Grows online consumer brands: customer acquisition, retention, lifetime value, Shopify, influencers and UGC.
dtc-growth-strategist.try: How do I get more repeat purchases on my Shopify store?

performance-marketer.title: Performance Marketer
performance-marketer.summary: Plans and fixes paid social campaigns on Meta, TikTok and YouTube: structure, budgets and creative tests.
performance-marketer.try: My Meta ads return dropped this month. What should I test first?

copywriting.title: Sales Copywriting
copywriting.summary: Writes cold outreach, sales emails, LinkedIn messages and call scripts.
copywriting.try: Write a cold email to a startup that just raised its seed round.

copy-editing.title: Sales Copy Editing
copy-editing.summary: Edits sales emails, messages and scripts so they are shorter, clearer and more likely to get a reply.
copy-editing.try: Edit this outreach email so it's shorter and clearer: …

email-sequence.title: Follow-up Sequences
email-sequence.summary: Builds multi-step outreach sequences and follow-up timing.
email-sequence.try: Create a 4-email follow-up sequence for leads who saw my portfolio.

objection-handling.title: Objection Handling
objection-handling.summary: Helps you answer pushback like "too expensive" or "not now" without getting defensive.
objection-handling.try: A client says my day rate is too high. How do I respond?

sales-psychology.title: Sales Psychology
sales-psychology.summary: Explains how buyers decide and how to persuade ethically in sales conversations.
sales-psychology.try: Why do prospects go quiet after I send a proposal, and what can I do?

storytelling.title: Sales Storytelling
storytelling.summary: Turns projects and results into short stories that make the benefit concrete and memorable.
storytelling.try: Turn this client project into a short case-study story for a pitch.

social-proof-injection.title: Social Proof
social-proof-injection.summary: Picks the right testimonial or case study to mention for each prospect.
social-proof-injection.try: Which of my past projects should I mention to a fintech lead?

urgency-creation.title: Urgency Without Pressure
urgency-creation.summary: Adds real time-sensitivity to an offer without sounding pushy.
urgency-creation.try: How can I give my offer a deadline that feels fair?

scarcity-urgency-calibration.title: Urgency Check
scarcity-urgency-calibration.summary: Judges when time pressure helps a deal and when it backfires.
scarcity-urgency-calibration.try: Is it OK to tell a lead I only have one slot left this quarter?

ab-message-testing.title: Message A/B Testing
ab-message-testing.summary: Sets up tests of two or more message versions to see which gets more replies.
ab-message-testing.try: Give me two versions of this LinkedIn message to test.

analytics-tracking.title: Sales Metrics
analytics-tracking.summary: Sets up and audits what to track in a sales pipeline.
analytics-tracking.try: What should I track in my outreach pipeline each week?

customer-referrals.title: Referrals & Partners
customer-referrals.summary: Gets referrals from past clients and builds partner channels for new work.
customer-referrals.try: How do I ask past clients for referrals without it feeling awkward?

tech-entrepreneur.title: Founder Co-pilot
tech-entrepreneur.summary: Thinks with you like a co-founder: ideas, validation, what to build first, competitors and go-to-market.
tech-entrepreneur.try: I have an idea for an app. Help me check if it's worth building.

financial-modeler.title: Financial Modeler
financial-modeler.summary: Builds revenue projections, pricing tiers, unit economics and runway estimates.
financial-modeler.try: Model three pricing tiers for a subscription app.

ai-workflow-engineer.title: AI Workflow Engineer
ai-workflow-engineer.summary: Designs AI automations, prompt systems and API pipelines with Claude, OpenAI and image or video models.
ai-workflow-engineer.try: Design a pipeline that turns one brief into ten ad image variations.

no-code-builder.title: No-Code Builder
no-code-builder.summary: Builds products and automations with Framer, Webflow, Bubble, Zapier, Make, Supabase, Airtable and Stripe.
no-code-builder.try: How do I add paid sign-ups to my Framer site?

genjutsu-video-workflow.title: Genjutsu Video Swap
genjutsu-video-workflow.summary: Replaces the person or object in a video with the open-source Genjutsu workflow. Makes a draft first, then the HD version, and keeps the original audio.
genjutsu-video-workflow.try: Swap the person in this clip for my 3D character.

landscape-research.title: Landscape Research
landscape-research.summary: Runs a research cycle for the Landscape map: finds new creative-industry organizations and re-checks old records.
landscape-research.try: Run a research cycle on Tel Aviv design studios.
